final: WITH base AS (SELECT oi.order_item_id AS item_id, c.town_city AS town, ili.product_price AS price, CAST(ili.derived_product_cost AS REAL) / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0) AS ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id), grp AS (SELECT item_id, town, AVG(price) AS avg_price, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM base GROUP BY item_id, town), town_avg AS (SELECT town, AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price_avg, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio_avg FROM grp GROUP BY town), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio_avg) AS overall_avg FROM town_avg) SELECT t.town, t.avg_price_avg, t.avg_ratio_avg, t.avg_ratio_avg - o.overall_avg AS diff FROM town_avg t CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND t.avg_ratio_avg > o.overall_avg
